host.description: Loopback or explicit tailnet IPv4 only; no wildcard bind.

profile.description: Private model-scoped PCA probe directory; no assets committed.

provider.description: Explicit inference provider; never automatically substituted.

native_cli.description: Trusted native spqx executable with frozen/PCA operations. Current live native provider is Linux GGML/CUDA.

native_config.description: Explicit spqx config selecting pinned Base GGUF/codec/runtime/device.

native_registry.description: Canonical voqx registry root override; otherwise native CLI uses XDG voice-registry.

rating_bank.description: Private version1 vector-only audition bank. Enables manual ratings, not synthesis or canonical saving.

curation_bank.description: Separate SHA-bound frozen audition bank for explicit keep/reject/unsure reviews at /curation. No inference, numeric default scores or enrollment.

curation_banks.description: Additional operator-configured private banks, selectable by short key; never a browser-provided filesystem path.

python.description: Existing SDK environment Python, invoked via uv.
